text.p: These are the leading stories in the Egyptian press on Tuesday. Reuters has not verified these stories and does not vouch for their accuracy.

- Egypt selected to coordinate a new project of promoting products of the group of eight developing countries. Egyptian President Hosni Mubarak receives a report from Prime Minister Kamal Ganzouri on the outcome of Istanbul summit of Islmaic states.

- Mubarak to hold talks with French President Jacques Chirac in Paris on Thursday. The talks will cover the Middle East peace process. Foreign Minister Amr Moussa will start on Wednesday a European tour, which will take him also to Italy and Britain.
- Defence Minister Mohamed Hussein Tantawi to discuss with his French counterpart the cooperation between the countries in the fields of training and armament.
- The joint Egyptian-Jordanian committee will meet in Cairo on July 5. The meeting will be co-chaired by Ganzouri and Jordanian Prime Minister Abdul-Salam al-Majali.
- Defence Minister Tantawi says in Paris, "France confirms its willingness to boost our armed forces."
- Public Enterprise Minister Atef Obeid says that foreigners will not be allowed to buy film studios and the activity of movie theatres cannot be changed.
